evidenceLayers.attdefPairMatched: Frozen source callback model/original state agrees with the later typed callback; not raw-body agreement
evidenceLayers.attdefFieldsMatched: Shared decoder replay of admitted raw transport agrees with modeled fields and original state; not independent semantics or a complete source profile

implementation.pairing: Single source-before-typed pair, sticky duplicate/wrong-family/identity/session failures and constant-time pending count at closure; no repeated whole-model scan
implementation.modelComparison: Bitwise doubles/coordinates, complete dwgHandle and pending-ref components, common/native-only/default/text/attribute/nested-MTEXT/proxy/app/XDATA fields; parser state separately observed before model copies reset it
implementation.context: Actual modern version/ASCII-or-binary carrier; converter fileImport actually requests applyExtrusion=false and context is checked accordingly; enclosing block callback values retained but not themselves block-source proof
implementation.replay: Bounded original ASCII spellings or exact Binary-DXF scalar transport, dxfAttdef::Decoder required fields/parseApplication/finish, matched original cursor/subclass/grammar state
implementation.preflight: Scalar-only raw carriers and declared identity/version/context checked; native writer-only EED binding vectors refused before copying
implementation.accounting: Shared record/item/byte/work precharge; frozen model plus conservative extra model copy allowance, raw transport/token/decoder allowances, reader record/input/token/decode/node/retained ceilings
implementation.accountingLimits: Logical conservative allowances, not exact capacity, all allocations, whole-model RSS or strict CPU bounds; failures may retain charged prefixes, never clear evidence failure in place
implementation.exceptionPolicy: Existing fileImport contract records readThrew and propagates callback exceptions; fresh-data/session retry on same adapter

owningControls.richScope: Four versions, ASCII/binary and both sections, with nondefault host/nested common fields, proxy bytes/provenance and true-color/background names/transparency; modeled field values only, no target/rendering/whole-drawing qualification
owningControls.callbackFieldScope: One canonical mutable parser-owned record, changing one field without copy/reset of unrelated state; includes native/private/grammar/handle components and signed zero, not a full version/profile/field Cartesian product
owningControls.rawFieldScope: Consistent raw scalar/spelling mutations of host text/tag/prompt/coordinate, nested text, opaque app/CIF payload and XDATA; additional contradictory spelling control
owningControls.allocationScope: Every observed allocation in each calibrated canonical interval. Consumer retention can fail after valid source evidence, so combined evidence/consumer completeness is checked; not every import/process allocation.
owningControls.immutableOwners: Mutable raw callback aliases and later editable text/XDATA cannot change frozen evidence; XDATA owners are distinct
owningControls.originalStateLaunderingControl: Real partial-XDATA source retains pending cursor in original observation although copied model clears it; modeled agreement remains false
specialControls: missing source not synthesized from typed

integrationCountCorrection.correction: Observed Bound/results unchanged; proof-record counts include two new provisional ATTDEF candidates: 14 to 16, 15 to 17; added assertions for paired/modeled agreement with rawTypedMatched false
